subject: VPC starter pilot — amortization, support tiers & billing construct
messages:
From: Althea Health Procurement <procurement@altheahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Lee <g.lee@altheahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Request: starter bundle construct + platform fee amortization

Hi Irene,

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick follow-up from our procurement side — we'd like a written breakdown of the commercial options for a private VPC deployment. Please include:

- A starter/pilot bundle (3–6 month) with any pilot credits and a clear conversion path.
- How the platform fee can be amortized against committed nodes or over time (12/18/24 months).
- Support tier definitions (response SLAs, hours included, & how added hours are billed).
- Any conditional discounts for multi-year commits or headcount-based operator licensing.

We attach our procurement policy and a sample invoice cadence for reference. Our CFO (Dan Wu) wants top-line year 1 vs year 2 TCO for comparison, and the engineering lead Grace will provide a usage forecast by EOD Thursday.

Could you return a corporate-level example commercial by Friday 5/15? We need this for our internal approval meeting on 5/20.

Thanks,
— Althea Procurement Team
[Attachment: Althea_Procurement_Policy.pdf (pdf)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Althea Health Procurement <procurement@altheahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: starter bundle construct + platform fee amortization

Hi — thanks for the clear list. Below is an example set of commercial options we can formalize into a PDF with line-item 1/2-year TCO tables. I put conservative numbers so we can compress if you share your forecast.

Option A — Starter Pilot (3 months)
- Pilot credits: $50k of inference credits, valid for 90 days; additional usage billed at metered rates.
- Platform fee: one-time $25k starter platform fee (can be amortized over 12 months at customer request).
- Support: Standard (business hours) included for pilot; upgrade to Silver for 24/7 with 4h response at $3k/mo during pilot.

Option B — Pilot-to-Commit (6 months then convert)
- Pilot credits: $75k with conversion credit of 50% of unused credits if converted to a 12+ month committed plan.
- Platform fee: normally $60k/year; amortization examples: 12m ($5k/mo), 18m ($3.3k/mo), 24m ($2.5k/mo).
- Support tiers: Bronze (8x5, 24h response), Silver (24x7, 4h), Gold (24x7, 1h + designated SRE cadence). Gold includes 40 engineering hours for migration in year 1.

Conditional discounts we can consider:
- 20% off platform fee for an 18-month committed capacity with a min node-floor.
- Waive operator license for pilots converting to committed plans within 60 days.

Next steps from our side: I’ll pull together a sample TCO table (Y1/Y2) and a formal pilot SOW for you by Friday 5/15. Could you confirm Grace’s forecast numbers when available?

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ALTHEA_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf (proposal)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Althea Health Procurement <procurement@altheahealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: VPC starter pilot — amortization, support tiers & billing construct

Irene — forwarding for commercial ops input. A couple of pragmatic concessions we can offer to accelerate: 

- If Althea commits to a 24-month reserved capacity (min annual spend $1.5M), we can reduce platform fee by 25% in year 1 and include 80 migration hours (engineering) pro-rated.
- Offer a 15% pilot discount on pilot credits to shorten procurement cycles.
- Swap to quarterly invoicing for platform fee during pilot and monthly after conversion.

Operational asks: Marissa/Monica, please prepare a short annex that maps credit usage to expected token throughput so we can show Dan the TCO math he asked for. If procurement asks for operator-license removal, propose the waiver only on conversion not on standalone pilot.

-David

From: Dan Wu (CFO) <dan.wu@altheahealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Lee <g.lee@altheahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC starter pilot — amortization, support tiers & billing construct

Irene / team —

Thanks for the options. A few clarifying asks before we proceed to the internal approval: 

1) Please produce a Year-1 and Year-2 cashflow table (not just amortized monthly) that shows: platform fee, support, credits consumed, any migration hour offsets, and net TCO for each option (A/B and the 24m commit).
2) Operator license: procurement policy does not allow ongoing per-operator charges without headcount justification. Can Redwood remove the operator license line entirely from the commercial and fold necessary operator access into the support band for year 1?
3) What are the SLA financial remedies (service credits) for missed 1h/4h response times in Gold/Silver? We need explicit credit % per incident and cap.

Attached are our annotated redlines to ALTHEA_PROPOSAL_v2.pdf. Grace will share the forecast later today. If you can get the Y1/Y2 cashflow by COB 5/15 that will allow us to push this to legal on 5/18.

Regards,
Dan Wu
CFO, Althea Health
[Attachment: Althea_Redlines_20260515.docx (redlines)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Althea Health Procurement <procurement@altheahealth.com>, Dan Wu <dan.wu@altheahealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC starter pilot — amortization, support tiers & billing construct

Dan / team —

Appreciate the quick turn. Attached is a concise commercial annex and Y1/Y2 cashflow table that reflects the asks and an updated SLA appendix. High level summary of the final commercial we can commit to for legal review: 

- Pilot (3 months): $50k credits + platform fee amortized option. Pilot discount applied: 15% off credits. Quarterly platform fee invoicing during pilot.
- Conversion incentive: if converted to a 18-month committed capacity within 60 days of pilot end we will:
  * Apply a 20% platform fee discount in year 1 (after conversion),
  * Waive operator-license fees for year 1 and fold operator access into Gold support band,
  * Include 60 migration hours (additional 20 hours on top of Gold).
- 24-month commit alternative: 25% platform fee reduction in year 1 + 80 migration hours (per David’s suggestion).

SLA credits (summary):
- Gold (1h response): 5% service credit of monthly platform fee per qualified SLA breach, capped at 50% of monthly fee per quarter.
- Silver (4h response): 2.5% credit per breach, cap 25% per quarter.

Next steps (MAP):
1) Althea to confirm forecast and chosen commercial path by 5/20.
2) Redwood to issue revised PDF Annex + DocuSign (I will send this morning).
3) Legal review target: returning redlines by 5/24.

I’m attaching the updated proposal and the SLA appendix for your legal/commercial teams. If this aligns I’ll route a DocuSign with the annex and SOW for signature.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-support-SLA-appendix.docx (docx)]
